text:
Maya (CS): Hey team — quick heads up from ListenLab kickoff today. They surfaced three small but blocking asks from their onboarding: 1) per-route cost preview in the console, 2) bulk-upload for prompt templates, 3) clearer retry behavior when Dedicated capacity throttles. They called the cost view "make-or-break" for their finance sign-off.
Arjun (PM): Thanks — can you drop the exact customer wording and any screenshots/notes? We should triage for next sprint if it's high ROI.
Maya (CS): Copied here the verbatim note from their onboarding lead: "We need to show finance what this will cost at scale — a per-route estimate with our expected qps and average tokens. Without that we can't commit." Also attached a small CSV of their sample routes (pasted below).
Maya (CS): ```route_name,qps,avg_tokens
inference-chat,5,120
embeddings-batch,2,1024
rerank-fast,20,40```
Nina (CS): Also they asked for bulk prompt upload — they have ~250 templates for different intents, currently doing each manually in the Console. That’s blocking their enablement.
Liam (Eng): For the retry behavior — sounds like our Dedicated throttling fallback to Hosted is working but not obvious in logs. Do we have an existing UX pattern for showing fallback events? If not, we can add a per-request note + metrics flag.
Arjun (PM): Prioritize: cost preview (P0 for renewal), bulk upload (P1), retry visibility (P2). Maya — is renewal date within 60d?
Maya (CS): Yes — renewal window is 45 days and finance lead escalated this during the call. Renewal risk = elevated. :warning:
Sam (Data): I can run quick cost projections using their CSV. If we assume model X at 0.0008 per token and batching 40% effective, rough monthly delta = ~$Xk. Will post numbers by EOD.
Arjun (PM): Cool — if Sam posts numbers and they're material, we should scope a Console quickview prototype and a CLI rough estimate tool. Liam — can you estimate engineering effort for a simple per-route table + export? 3 days?
Liam (Eng): 3-5 dev days + a small backend calc job. Can do a lightweight MVP that reads route configs + qps and outputs projected monthly tokens/cost. Will need a tiny UI slot in Console.
Maya (CS): Next steps: (1) Sam posts cost calc by EOD, (2) Arjun to make a short PRD stub and tag eng, (3) I'll send ListenLab a temporary spreadsheet with manual estimates to buy time.
ProdBot: Created ticket PROD-4821: "ListenLab — per-route cost preview MVP" assigned to @Liam (Eng), priority: high.
Arjun (PM): Tagging @Liam and @Sam on PROD-4821. I'll add bulk-upload as separate ticket and include sample CSV spec.
Nina (CS): Small ask — can we include a bulk-import template header in the ticket so enablement can start mapping fields? Saves cycles.
Maya (CS): Yep — I'll paste a template into the ticket. Also asked ListenLab if they'd accept a spreadsheet interim — they said yes if numbers look reasonable.
Sam (Data): Posting quick projection: assuming configs above + model cost assumptions, estimated incremental monthly = "~$2.6k"; with caching/batching could drop to ~$1.8k. I'll attach calc in the ticket.
Arjun (PM): That number should unblock finance convo. I'll circulate PRD stub and schedule a 30-min sync with ListenLab next week.
Maya (CS): Thanks all — tagging this as high urgency for the renewal. Will update thread after the sync. :thumbsup:
